authority: Routing and retrieval scores are evaluation evidence only; durable evidence, lifecycle/lineage, citation, pack, and security semantics remain authoritative.

decision.reason: router does not materially improve matched quality or latency without regressions

rule.material_latency_gain: At least 10 percent lower policy p95 latency including deterministic classification overhead, with no quality regression.
rule.material_quality_gain: At least 0.05 absolute improvement in hit rate, recall@5, MRR, or final-answer correctness, or a reduction in decision-critical misses.
rule.no_regressions: Every routed retrieval and answer/citation/security metric and every decision-critical case must be no worse than fixed RAW_RERANKED.
rule.otherwise: REJECT_ROUTING or DEFER_ROUTING; do not build an LLM planner
